name: n8n-1.1-sla-reminder-crm-NEGATIVE-FIXTURE
_purpose: Negative graph fixture for the local runner. Encodes the C-N11-01 graph violations that T0 caught in the previous candidate. The runner MUST detect these via validateGraphInvariants / validateStructure so they cannot be silently re-introduced.
_violations: C-N11-01 violation A: Build sendSyntheticReminder batches fan-out -> HTTP Send AND Build ack from send (not just Build ack from fallback).
C-N11-01 violation B: Build ack from send does not converge with Build ack from fallback on the same Build acknowledgement batches input (different input indices but no dedupe guard).
C-N11-03 violation A: ack envelope uses Date.now() / Math.random() inside its idempotencyKey (the key is non-deterministic across replays).
C-N11-04 violation A: httpRequest node declares a non-n8n-valid httpNodeCredential field instead of authentication.type.
C-N11-04 violation B: signerProfile.kind is not BLOCKED_BY_N8N_SIGNER_DECISION.
